title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant - Part-Time

Location: Headlands Grove, Swindon

Hours: Tuesday and Wednesday, 8:00am-4:00pm

Break: 30-minute unpaid break each day

Total: 15 hours per week

Salary: £30,000 per annum (pro rata £12,000 pa)

Pay: Weekly

Contract: Permanent, part-time

A part-time role with plenty to get involved in

We're looking for an organised, dependable and detail-focused Accounts Assistant to join the team.

Working closely with our Head of Accounts, you'll help keep the day-to-day finances running smoothly-from processing invoices and reconciling statements to answering queries and supporting the wider Accounts Department.

This isn't a role where you'll simply be left to enter figures all day. We're looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of their work, spotting when something doesn't look quite right and helping to keep an important part of the business organised and on track.

What you'll be doing
- Processing supplier invoices and credit notes accurately
- Matching invoices against purchase orders and supporting documents
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date purchase ledger records
- Reconciling supplier statements and investigating discrepancies
- Responding to supplier and internal payment queries
- Supporting payment preparation and account reconciliations
- Processing expenses and other financial documentation
- Keeping accounting records organised and easy to access
- Assisting the Head of Accounts with day-to-day financial administration
- Getting involved with wider finance duties and reporting when needed

What we're looking for

You'll ideally have previous experience in an accounts, finance or purchase ledger role, but just as importantly, you'll be someone who is:
- Confident working with numbers and financial information
- Naturally organised with excellent attention to detail
- Comfortable using accounting software and Microsoft Excel
- Able to manage priorities and meet deadlines
- Happy to work independently while remaining part of the wider team
- Professional, approachable and confident communicating with suppliers and colleagues
- Willing to ask questions, solve problems and take responsibility for getting things right

Why join?

You'll be joining an established and growing home-improvement business in a role that offers fixed weekday hours, a supportive working environment and the opportunity to make a genuine contribution to the Accounts Department.

If you enjoy bringing order to the numbers, solving the occasional financial mystery and being the person others can rely on, we'd love to hear from you.

Equals One is an advertising and recruitment agency working on behalf of our client to promote this vacancy. You may be contacted directly by the employer should they wish to progress your application. Due to the number of applications we receive, we are unable to provide specific feedback if your application is unsuccessful.

title: Bookkeeper/Payroll
description:
This bookkeeping and payroll role in Marlborough is all about keeping financial records accurate and organised while ensuring smooth payroll management. It's a key position in the professional services industry that helps the business maintain efficient financial operations.

Client Details

This professional services company is based in Marlborough and operates within the accounting and finance sector.

Description
- Manage daily bookkeeping tasks to maintain accurate financial records.
- Process payroll efficiently and ensure compliance with relevant regulations.
- Reconcile accounts and resolve discrepancies promptly.
- Prepare financial reports and support month-end processes.
- Handle VAT submissions and other statutory requirements.
- Collaborate with colleagues to streamline accounting processes.
- Maintain confidentiality and security of financial data.
- Respond to client queries related to payroll and bookkeeping.

Profile

A successful Bookkeeper/Payroll professional should have:
- Strong bookkeeping and payroll management skills.
- Experience with accounting software and tools.
- A solid understanding of VAT and statutory requirements.
- Attention to detail and excellent organisational skills.
- The ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
- Good communication skills for client and team interactions.

Job Offer
- Salary between £30,000 and £32,000 dependent on the level of experience.
- Hybrid working arrangement for better work-life balance.
- Permanent position within the professional services industry.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Part-time Finance Officer
description:
We're excited to be working on the behalf of a well-regarded local heritage charity, who are seeking a new Finance Officer to join their friendly team. Duties will include:
- Banking and reconciling weekly takings, identifying any discrepancies
- Sales invoices & credit control
- Processing purchase invoices and making payment runs
- Processing monthly payroll & pensions
- Preparation of monthly management accounts & financial reporting
- Preparing and submitting Gift Aid returns
- Monitoring cash flow
- Quarterly VAT returns including partial exemption
- Liaising with auditors regarding annual accouns
- Other general duties such as assisting with HR as needed, liaising with various members of other departments to ensure everything runs smoothly, participating in training and development as needed, etc

You will need previous experience using Xero software for accounts, and any knowledge of Sage HR /Payroll would be beneficial. A background in charity accounting would be highly beneficial / knowledge of Gift Aid / partial exemption VAT, etc, however this is not essential. AAT Level 4 or equivalent qualification would be beneficial, however the charity can considered those qualified by experience. This role would definitely suit anyone with an interest in heritage / history / education.

The organisation are looking for someone to work circa 21 hours per week and can be flexible regarding how this is spread, to suit the right candidate. They would like the person to be in-office.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Payroll Administrator

Location: Amesbury, Wiltshire - 3 days per week onsite

Salary: £27,000 pa - £30,000 pa DOE.

Security Clearance: Must be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance.

About the role

We are working with a leading UK organisation to recruit a Payroll Administrator to join their Employee Services team based in Amesbury.

This is a great opportunity for someone with previous payroll experience who enjoys working in a customer-focused environment and is looking to develop their career within a large, established organisation. You will provide day-to-day payroll and employee services support, helping to ensure payroll is processed accurately, on time and in line with relevant legislation and company procedures.

Key responsibilities
- Provide first-line payroll support to employees via phone, email and the Employee Services Helpdesk.
- Deliver a high level of customer service to all employees and internal customers.
- Support the administration and processing of three different payrolls.
- Process payroll files in line with agreed payroll schedules and cut-off dates.
- Ensure payroll activities comply with HMRC requirements and internal payroll policies and procedures.
- Maintain compliance with GDPR and organisational policies when handling sensitive employee information.
- Liaise with relevant third parties and external providers where required.
- Investigate and resolve payroll queries accurately and efficiently.
- Support the wider Employee Services team with planned and ad-hoc activities as required.

About you

We are looking for someone with:
- Previous experience working within payroll.
- A good understanding of payroll processes and HMRC requirements.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Excellent customer service and communication skills.
- The ability to manage confidential and sensitive information appropriately.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to work to deadlines and payroll cut-offs.
- CIPP certification or currently working towards CIPP certification.
- A proactive and reliable approach, with the ability to work independently and as part of a wider team.

Security Clearance

Due to the nature of the organisation and role, candidates must be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance.

What's on offer?
- Hybrid working with 3 days per week onsite in Amesbury.
- Opportunity to join a well-established UK organisation.
- Career development within Employee Services and Payroll.
- One-stage interview process.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

By applying you are confirming you are happy to be added to the Addition Solutions mailing list regarding future suitable positions. You can opt out of this at any time simply by contacting one of our consultants.
